title: Compare AI Agents in a Real-World Scenario
job_text: 1. Collect data on the outputs of multiple AI agents in a real-world setting. Look at publicly available videos or web pages that demonstrate their performance. 2. Decide which AI agents perform best by comparing their results. 3. Record your observations and results. 4. Limit your comparison to a specific task or domain, such as language translation or image recognition.
what_happened: The author compared the performance of multiple AI agents in a real-world scenario, noting the implications for future AI development.
